empty.body: Enter the companion code you were sent to see what she shares with you.

tips.menstrual_note: {name} may feel more tired or be in pain these days. Rest, warmth and help with daily chores matter most.

menstrual_tip_1.title: Make her a warm drink
menstrual_tip_1.body: A herbal tea or a glass of warm water can feel comforting.

menstrual_tip_2.title: Take over one chore
menstrual_tip_2.body: Fewer daily tasks give her room to rest.

menstrual_tip_3.title: Ask what she needs
menstrual_tip_3.body: Sometimes listening and being there is enough.

tips.follicular_note: {name}'s energy usually rises in these days. A good time for plans together.

follicular_tip_1.title: Plan an outing together
follicular_tip_1.body: A walk, a film or seeing friends — something you both enjoy.

follicular_tip_2.title: Back her new plans
follicular_tip_2.body: If she has a new goal, cheer her on and help.

follicular_tip_3.title: 20 minutes of exercise together
follicular_tip_3.body: Light movement lifts both of you.

tips.fertile_note: These are usually the most energetic days of {name}'s cycle.

fertile_tip_1.title: Make calm time for two
fertile_tip_1.body: A simple dinner or an unhurried talk is enough.

fertile_tip_2.title: Ask about her plans
fertile_tip_2.body: Showing interest in what she does means a lot.

fertile_tip_3.title: Go out together
fertile_tip_3.body: Fresh air and movement are good for you both.

tips.luteal_note: {name} may feel more tired or sensitive these days. Patience and help with daily chores matter most.

luteal_tip_1.title: Cook a light, warm dinner
luteal_tip_1.body: Warm, low-salt food helps her feel better these days.

luteal_tip_2.title: Take a 20-minute walk together
luteal_tip_2.body: Light movement helps with cramps and stress.

luteal_tip_3.title: Be patient and listen
luteal_tip_3.body: If she is short-tempered, do not take it personally; ask how you can help.

tips.pregnancy_note: {name} is pregnant. Coming along to appointments and easing daily chores help most.

pregnancy_tip_1.title: Join her next appointment
pregnancy_tip_1.body: Being there at visits reassures her.

pregnancy_tip_2.title: Do the heavy lifting
pregnancy_tip_2.body: Take over shopping, carrying and tiring chores.

pregnancy_tip_3.title: Prepare a healthy snack
pregnancy_tip_3.body: Keep fruit, water and a light snack within her reach.

tips.general_note: Whatever {name} shares with you shows up here.

general_tip_1.title: Check in on her
general_tip_1.body: A short message during the day shows you are thinking of her.

general_tip_2.title: Take over one task
general_tip_2.body: Lightening the daily load always helps.

general_tip_3.title: Make time for two
general_tip_3.body: Even 20 minutes of talking or walking together counts.
